result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility issue: text inside the promotional banner has severely insufficient color contrast against its light background.

issues.description: The promotional banner displays white text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') against a very pale mint-green background, making the heading and promo code instructions nearly illegible and failing WCAG contrast standards.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color (such as dark green or near-black) on the light green banner, or darken the banner's background color so white text achieves at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
